topic: Why does a crowd start clapping in rhythm all on its own?
title: Why Does a Crowd Start Clapping in Rhythm All on Its Own?
description:
A crowd claps loudly, and then - with no one leading it - everyone falls into the same rhythm together. It's the same kind of self-organized sync that makes fireflies flash as one. Up next: why the Tacoma Narrows Bridge tore itself apart in the wind. #clapping #synchronization #crowdscience #physics
